story.i_want: Update the current API implementation to utilize a real SQL database connection with connection string managed by configuration
story.so_that: The application can persist data reliably across application restarts and support production-grade data storage instead of in-memory repositories

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Connection string is read from appsettings.json configuration
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given appsettings.json contains a valid connection string, When the application starts, Then it connects to the specified SQL database

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Account and transaction data models are properly mapped to database entities
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the Account and Transaction domain models exist, When data is persisted to SQL, Then the schema correctly represents the domain model

related_edge_cases.criterion: Connection string is missing or invalid
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given appsettings.json has no connection string, When the application starts, Then it fails with a clear error
Given the database exists but tables do not, When the application starts, Then migrations create the required schema

steps.description: Configure environment-specific connection strings in appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json
Configure ApplicationDbContext with Entity Framework Core - Define DbSet<Account> and DbSet<Transaction> properties and OnModelCreating mappings
depends_on: Configure environment-specific connection strings in appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json

steps.description: Implement database migrations to automatically create Account and Transaction tables with constraints and indexes
depends_on: Configure ApplicationDbContext with Entity Framework Core - Define DbSet<Account> and DbSet<Transaction> properties and OnModelCreating mappings
